MATH 120: Precalculus
Fall 2026, Section 03. Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 10:00-10:50.

Textbook: Precalculus by Jay Abramson et al., OpenStax (free online).

Course description
Functions and their graphs, matrices and systems of equations, in preparation for calculus.

Schedule
Week 1 (Aug 31 - Sep 4): Functions and function notation. Read 1.1.
Week 2 (Sep 8 - Sep 11): Domain and range, interval notation. Read 1.2.
Week 3 (Sep 14 - Sep 18): Review of Unit 1 and Quiz 1 (Friday).
Week 4 (Sep 21 - Sep 25): Matrices and matrix operations: addition, scalar multiples, matrix products. Read 9.5.
Week 5 (Sep 28 - Oct 2): Solving systems with Gaussian elimination. Read 9.6.
Week 6 (Oct 5 - Oct 9): Midterm exam on Friday, October 9, covering weeks 1-5.

Grading
Homework 20%
Quiz 1 10%
Midterm exam 30%
Final exam 40% (cumulative), December 14.

Office hours: Tuesday 2-4 pm, Math building room 210.
Academic integrity: all work you submit must be your own.
